description: I’m getting several DMs a day from brands asking for junior creative strategists… what’s the deal here?
transcript: I'm gonna keep it 100 with you. I thought that AI was gonna kill off junior roles this year. So why is it that there has literally never been more brands reaching out to me asking for junior creative strategist? I have a few hot takes on this one. Yeah, the last one is my most unpopular. Number one, the junior creative strategist market absolutely loaded. And I think it's all due to motions creative strategy boot Camp that happened a few months ago. Actually, take a look at the Google search trends for creative strategy. Like that is the ad campaign that motion ran. And number two is that it is really fucking hard to hire creative strategy leadership right now. I've actually had a number of conversations with other agency operators and people who work brand side that are trying to hire a creative strategy director or hire. And what they are finding is that the best, the best experience, like the best agencies or the best brand experience doesn't actually correlate with the best results. A lot of brands have figured out, hey, it's actually the strength of your systems in your SOP's that can guarantee more consistent or better results over a longer period of time instead of that fabled 10 out of 10 creative strategist. And finally, and this is the one that I feel the most uncomfortable talking about because I want creative strategists to build wealth, to make their coin, to have thriving Careers like that is the whole reason why I have this platform. However, I have noticed that there is a lot of entitlement when you are hiring. I don't think that this is the fault of creative strategist though. I think that the mid career to leadership tier roles are so un clearly defined in our industry, so it makes it really hard to gauge. Hey, what does a senior creative strategist look like versus a director of creative strategy? Versus someone who's more at that VP of growth level? Think the people who stay and to gain the most from this confusion are junior creative strategist right now. So if you are actually interested in learning more about these junior creative strategy roles, be sure to follow me. I'm gonna share more about this tomorrow.
